query: /* postgres */ update t_scan set status = $1, findings_count = $2, new_issues_count = $3, resolved_issues_count = $4, duration_ms = $5, sbom = coalesce($6, sbom), project_type = case when $7 then $8 else project_type end, version = case when $7 then $9 else version end, error = $10, plugin_steps = $11, detected_languages = $12, examined_types = coalesce($13, examined_types), claimed_by = null, claimed_at = null, lease_expires_at = null where id = $14
